claims.evidence: The witness report explicitly states that the engine running condition and operational status were not shown.
The witness confirmed a white truck with an orange drilling rig mounted on the back.
There is no proof of the rig's depth capacity or the condition of the hydraulic pumps and hoses.

risks.risk: Engine or drivetrain failure in the Nissan Diesel truck
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting from cold and the truck driving through gears.

risks.risk: Hydraulic system failure (pumps, valves, or cylinders)
risks.proof: A video showing the hydraulic mast being fully raised and the leveling jacks deployed.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a complete hydraulic overhaul

risks.risk: Drill head or rotation gearbox malfunction
risks.proof: A video showing the drill head rotating at various speeds.

risks.risk: Undisclosed mechanical wear or structural cracks in the mast
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the mast welds and the main hydraulic cylinders.

proof_requests: Video of the truck engine running and the vehicle moving.
Video of the drilling rig performing a test rotation and mast lift.
Photos of the odometer and the interior of the truck cab.
Clear photos of the hydraulic pump and tank area to check for leaks.
Photos of the vehicle identification number (VIN) and registration papers.
response.reason: The identity of the asset as a Nissan Diesel UD truck-mounted rig is confirmed. It will be priced at its worst-case (non-operational) value until functional proof is provided.
